title: DNA opening during transcription initiation by RNA polymerase II in atomic detail.
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子定向分子动力学模拟揭示RNA聚合酶II启动过程中DNA解链的连续路径与蛋白-DNA相互作用机制，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且物理模拟方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: RNA polymerase II (RNAP II) synthesizes RNA by reading the DNA code. During transcription initiation, RNAP II opens the double-stranded DNA to expose the DNA template to the active site. The molecular interactions driving and controlling DNA opening are not well understood. We used all-atom steered molecular dynamics simulations to derive a continuous pathway of DNA opening in human RNAP II, involving a 55 A DNA strand displacement and a nearly 360 degrees  DNA helix rotation. To drive such large-scale transitions, we used a combination of RMSD-based collective variables, a newly designed rotational coordinate, and a path collective variable. The simulations reveal extensive interactions of the DNA with three conserved protein loops near the active site, namely with the rudder, fork loop 1, and fork loop 2. According to the simulations, DNA-protein interactions support DNA opening by a twofold mechanism; they catalyze DNA opening by attacking Watson-Crick hydrogen bonds, and they stabilize the open DNA bubble by the formation of a wide set of DNA-protein salt bridges.
abstract_zh: RNA聚合酶II（RNAP II）通过读取DNA编码来合成RNA。在转录起始过程中，RNAP II打开双链DNA，将DNA模板暴露于活性位点。驱动并控制DNA打开的分子相互作用尚不完全清楚。我们利用全原子定向分子动力学模拟，推导出人类RNAP II中DNA打开的连续路径，涉及55 Å的DNA链位移和近360度的DNA螺旋旋转。为驱动如此大规模的转变，我们结合了基于RMSD的集体变量、新设计的旋转坐标以及路径集体变量。模拟揭示了DNA与活性位点附近三个保守蛋白环（即舵区、叉环1和叉环2）之间的广泛相互作用。根据模拟结果，DNA-蛋白质相互作用通过双重机制支持DNA打开：它们通过攻击Watson-Crick氢键催化DNA打开，并通过形成广泛的DNA-蛋白质盐桥稳定开放的DNA泡。
